Download GTA San Andreas highly compressed Apk Obb (GTA SA) version 2.11.311, works for all Android device GPU perfectly.

Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas Description

Five years ago, Carl Johnson escaped from the pressures of life in Los Santos, San Andreas, a city tearing itself apart with gang trouble, drugs and corruption.

Where film stars and millionaires do their best to avoid the dealers and gangbangers. Now, it’s the early 90’s. Carl’s got to go home. His mother has been murdered, his family has fallen apart and his childhood friends are all heading towards disaster.

On his return to the neighborhood, a couple of corrupt cops frame him for homicide.

CJ is forced on a journey that takes him across the entire state of San Andreas, to save his family and to take control of the streets.

Related: GTA San Andreas Lite Apk Data 700 MB

Rockstar Games brings its biggest release to mobile yet with a vast open-world covering the state of San Andreas and its three major cities – Los Santos, San Fierro and Las Venturas – with enhanced visual fidelity and over 70 hours of gameplay.

Download GTA San Andreas Apk Obb Highly Compressed

Remember to follow the steps on how to install below. Older version of the GTA San Andreas has a highly compressed Obb file and a separate Apk App, in which the original size is 2.41 GB.

Note that, this is a heavy file, you need about 7 GB free space in your device memory before you download. 

To get unlimited amount of money, click resume game, unlimited money will be available.

How To Install

After downloading the single Apk of GTA San Andreas above, which is 2.42 GB, locate the in your downloads folder and click to begin installation process.

As for the older Version, which comes with separate obb and Apk files, kindly follow the steps below with images to install or set it up.

Older Version Of GTA San Andreas Apk Obb

Follow the steps above to install this older version of GTA San Andreas Mod Apk, download latest version of ZAchiver app to extract the obb file. Install only one Apk at a time please.

Apk II GTA SA Cleo Mod

GTA San Andreas Cleo Mod 2.00 Apk(16MB)

Data – Cleo Menu File 

Extract Cleo Menu data file with Zarchiver App by clicking on it, then click extract and immediately go to Android folder, enter data folder to extract it.

Data Cleo Menu (1 MB)

Highly Compressed Obb File

GTA SA Highly Compressed 2.10 (1.63 GB)

How To Install GTA San Andreas Apk Obb File Highly Compressed

Just follow the steps below:

  1. Download ZArchiver Pro Apk for Android.
  2. Using ZArchiver, locate where you download the Obb file and click on it, just like in the image below.
  3. Option menu will come up and then click extract button.
  4. Now click on the title folder at the top of Zarchiver app interface a drop down menu will appear and further click on Device Memory or Sdcard zero.
  5. Now locate and click Android folder, in it you will see obb folder, click on it and stop in the obb folder to extract.
  6. Automatically all other parts will be merged into one obb file (com.rockstargames.gtasa) by the Zarchiver engine and extracted completely.
  7. Finally locate GTA SA Normal Apk rar file and install.

Note that you must have enough space to avoid any error while extracting.
